name: Aki no Kaerimichi
source:
One autumn evening. You return home with your childhood friend Akino... but Akino suddenly says something strange... This is a slightly sad romance novel game using image generation AI.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3273760/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个秋天的傍晚。你和青梅竹马的秋野一起回到家……但是秋野突然说了一些奇怪的话……这是一款使用图像生成AI的略带悲伤的言情小说游戏。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3273760/]Steam[/url]]
